props.name: children
props.comment: Child field(s) rendered against the referenced record.

props.name: className
props.comment: A class name applied to the link wrapper.

props.name: empty
props.comment: Rendered when the FK is null/undefined or its record is missing. A string is translated.

props.name: error
props.comment: Rendered when the reference lookup errors.

props.name: loading
props.comment: Rendered while the referenced record is loading.

props.name: record
props.comment: The record to read the FK off. Defaults to the ambient record.

props.name: reference
props.comment: The referenced resource the FK points at (e.g. `"authors"`). A registered resource name.

props.name: render
props.comment:
Render-prop alternative to `children`: receives the resolved referenced
record. Called only after the reference resolves; loading, error and empty
states use their respective props.

props.name: source
props.comment: The FK field on the current record (e.g. `"author_id"`).
